name: aperture
description: Amber's desktop client — chat, live trace, and an SSH bridge Amber can drive.
author: Johnny Patino

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json && electron-vite build
scripts.verify: npm run verify:connection && npm run verify:voice && npm run verify:model && npm run verify:install && npm run verify:typeahead && npm run verify:theme && npm run verify:settings && npm run verify:bloom-keys && npm run verify:bloom-wire && npm run verify:bloom-client && npm run verify:bloom-stream && npm run verify:infra-redact && npm run verify:credentials && npm run verify:configuration && npm run verify:releases && npm run verify:registry && npm run verify:peers
scripts.verify:registry: esbuild src/shared/registry.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=out/verify/registry.mjs && esbuild src/renderer/infra/registry-layout.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=out/verify/registry-layout.mjs && esbuild src/main/infra/actions.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=out/verify/actions.mjs && node scripts/verify-registry.mjs
scripts.verify:voice: esbuild src/main/amber/voice.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=out/verify/voice.mjs && esbuild src/shared/voice.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=out/verify/voice-options.mjs && node scripts/verify-voice.mjs
scripts.verify:model: esbuild src/main/amber/model.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=out/verify/model.mjs && esbuild src/shared/models.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=out/verify/model-options.mjs && node scripts/verify-model.mjs
scripts.verify:infra-redact: esbuild src/main/infra/redact.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=out/verify/redact.mjs && esbuild src/main/infra/actions.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=out/verify/actions.mjs && node scripts/verify-infra-redact.mjs
scripts.verify:configuration: esbuild src/shared/credentials.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=out/verify/credentials.mjs && esbuild src/shared/configuration.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=out/verify/configuration.mjs && node scripts/verify-configuration.mjs
scripts.verify:peers: esbuild src/shared/peers.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=out/verify/peers.mjs && esbuild src/main/infra/actions.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=out/verify/actions.mjs && node scripts/verify-peers.mjs
